source.fit: per-layer prefill expert load of each source normalized to the same total, then summed
source.corpus: natural text only: English technical docs, English project descriptions, English and Chinese articles, a Chinese report, Python source, and the prefill part of a logit-validation prompt set (17 prompts, about 3,900-4,200 tokens each); random tokens and haystack prompts were used for evaluation only

note: slots 0..3 of each rank hold the primary copy of 4 experts (used by decode); slot 4 holds a prefill replica of a hot expert (row t of an expert with c copies goes to copy t mod c). The loader reads only format, n_routed_experts, ep_size, slots_per_rank and layers.
